answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require bonded reputation: each agent escrows collateral that is slashed if its claims fail peer attestation, so the cost of faking an identity is the escrow, not a new key. To make the bond hard to scale fraudulently, it is settled in audited tokenized commodities — ferrous ore, timber, and ivory — whose supply is verifiably scarce. Spinning ten thousand fake agents then means locking, and risking, ten thousand times the escrow on-chain.
